title: STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl to launch its first expansion 'Cost of Hope' on August 20
summary: The main expansion, along with free update 2.0, will arrive in August, offering dozens of hours of additional content.

title: Malware in Meccha Chameleon allows attackers to take control of PCs
summary: User-created maps and the game server were infected, compromising players' security before patches were released.

title: The Pokémon Company to use facial recognition in stores to combat card reselling
summary: The company will implement facial scanners in Japanese stores to verify buyers' identities and prevent resale.

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls faces technical issues on PC and Arc System Works apologizes
summary: The open beta of the fighting game suffered severe performance issues, leading the studio to issue a public apology.

title: Square Enix hints at more Final Fantasy remakes and possible new director for the saga
summary: The Final Fantasy producer discusses obstacles to future remakes and speculation about the director of the next main entry.

title: Capcom plans to release a Resident Evil each year and bets on remakes
summary: Capcom's strategy includes remakes of the saga to maintain interest between major releases, such as Pragmata.

title: Xbox servers suffer a global outage that blocks access to digital and physical games
summary: The Xbox Network service interruption affected millions of players, preventing them from playing both digital and physical titles.

title: PlayStation fans call for a week-long 'blackout' in protest against the possible end of physical discs
summary: The community organizes a boycott by turning off their consoles to show their rejection of Sony's digital strategy, after rumors that PlayStation will stop manufacturing discs.

title: Miyamoto believes that players no longer care about console technical specifications
summary: The veteran Nintendo designer believes the company should focus on offering unique gameplay instead of competing in raw power.

title: The Halo remake tops releases in Japan and contains a secret ending about the franchise's future
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved leads Japanese sales, while a hidden ending in the game hints at what's to come in the series.

title: Cyan Worlds shows a canceled Myst prototype and a trailer for a sequel that will never be released
summary: The developers of Myst reveal material from an abandoned project and a teaser for a new game that will not see the light of day.

title: Splatoon Raiders dominates Metacritic and UK sales charts
summary: The game receives high user ratings and dethrones Assassin's Creed Shadows on the British charts.

title: Baldur's Gate 3: a third-person camera mod divides the PC community
summary: Players debate whether the mod improves the experience or goes against Larian Studios' original vision.

title: An old Steam game goes viral by allowing players to play Undertale in online multiplayer
summary: The title 'Crashphalt' becomes an unexpected success as it is used by fans to play Undertale online.

title: Final Fantasy 14 plans two major reforms to its housing system
summary: Square Enix announces major changes to improve the housing system, one of the most requested features by players.

title: The actor from the Zelda movie talks about his role and his experience with Breath of the Wild
summary: The actor playing Link shares his memories of the game and how they influenced his performance for the movie.

title: Dan Houser, co-founder of Rockstar, defends the sale of games on physical disc
summary: The writer of GTA and Red Dead Redemption urges companies to offer discs if gamers want them, amid the debate about the digital future.
